normal.text: Hi @Orinks About a week or two ago I tried to submit a radio station through the website. It was for 98.5 KTIS out of Minnesota, and I was wanting to submit this to the list of radio stations in Freight Fate. I don't have an account, but it looked like it let me proceed without one, and it said that the station was submitted, and I just wanted to follow up with you about this. Is there anything else I need to do? Thanks for creating such a fun game! I've also discovered some really cool radio stations because of it, so thank you for adding this capability too. Thanks again! #FreightFate #games
